LightningComponentBundle.description: Drop-in replacement for the standard new/edit record form, powered by GraphQL instead of Apex.

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: API name of the object to edit or create. On a Record Page this is set automatically; required on an App Page.

property.name: recordTypeId
property.label: Record Type Id
property.description: Optional record type to use when creating a new record. If left blank, the user's default record type is used.

property.name: showCard
property.label: Show Lightning Card
property.description: If present, the form is wrapped in a lightning card with a title and icon.

property.name: cardIcon
property.label: Card Icon
property.description: If show card option is active, the SLDS icon displayed in the header, e.g. 'standard:account'.

property.name: hideCancelButton
property.label: Hide Cancel Button
property.description: If present, the Cancel button is hidden.

property.name: skipNavigateAfterSave
property.label: Skip Navigation After Save
property.description: If present, the form does not navigate to the saved record's view page after a successful save.
